items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Alton Redd on drums... I first hired Seymour Taylor... We had almost the same personnel. This time it was Alton Redd on drums

ctx.x:
Jonesy.
Alton Redd on drums, William
Woodman on trombone, and I first hired
Seymour Taylor on clarinet. After he was
there one week I got a fine clarinet man
named Albert Nicholas.

He went to Europe
and stayed a while.
